title: {{NAME}} and the Dinosaur Hero of the Valley
moral: Being brave means helping others, even when it is hard.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a bright yellow superhero cape with a red star, a red t-shirt, dark blue shorts, and red sneakers — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} ran through the tall green valley.
His yellow cape flapped in the wind.
Birds and squirrels watched from the trees.
A big red dinosaur stomped past.
He wore a cape too. A purple one.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} ran up to the red dinosaur.
"Are you a superhero too?" asked {{NAME}}.
The dinosaur turned and smiled.
"I try to be," he said softly.
{{NAME}}'s eyes lit up with excitement.

pages.content:
Then they heard a loud squeak.
A little rabbit was stuck in a tall tree.
She was too scared to climb down.
The dinosaur stretched his long neck way up.
{{NAME}} climbed onto the dinosaur's head to help.

{{NAME}} reached out his hands.
The rabbit grabbed on tight.
{{NAME}} lifted her down safely.
The rabbit hugged {{NAME}} very hard.
The birds and squirrels all cheered.

pages.content:
The rabbit danced happily in the grass.
The squirrels brought everyone acorn snacks.
The dinosaur and {{NAME}} sat down to rest.
"Real heroes help," said the dinosaur.
{{NAME}} felt proud and happy and very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow there is a new animal who needs a superhero like you.
